gates.name: Coverage policy
gates.pass_condition: overall statement >=90%/branch >=85%; core statement >=95%/branch >=90% per quality/convergence.json.coverage; the command's --fail-under=85 only floors coverage.py's combined statement+branch total and does not by itself assert any of these four thresholds
gates.note: owned by WI-000 (control-plane tooling, REQ-028); coverage runs via the authoritative unittest runner, not pytest (the legacy Tk GUI suite is flaky under pytest — see loop/quality/TOOLCHAIN_BASELINE.md). Measured 2026-07-15 (numbers in quality/convergence.json.coverage.current): combined total 86.8% would pass --fail-under=85, but all four documented thresholds fail (overall stmt 88.9/90, branch 78.8/85; core stmt 94.7/95, branch 87.8/90) — enabling today would certify a green the command never checks, so it stays disabled until the thresholds are met or the commands assert them per dimension. Coverage omits ui/_app_members.py (ADR-0014 type-only base, never imported at runtime; counting its 310 unexecutable declarations distorted the total to 82.7%).
